cancerLaterality.description: Laterality of the breast cancer. Use L for left, R for right, B for bilateral, or null if unknown/not documented.

tnmStage.description: Combined documented TNM stage, for example cT2N0M0 or pT1cN0M0. Do not infer. Use null if not explicitly documented.

radiotherapyReceived.description: Whether the patient received radiotherapy. Use Y if administered, N if explicitly not received, or null if unknown/not documented.

chemotherapyReceived.description: Whether the patient received chemotherapy. Use Y if administered, N if explicitly not received, or null if unknown/not documented.

surgeryReceived.description: Whether the patient underwent breast cancer surgery. Use Y if performed, N if explicitly not performed, or null if unknown/not documented.
